source.deposit_amount: deposit_data_amount decoded from UInt128 physical representation
source.net_locked_eth: deposit ETH minus principal-scale withdrawal ETH
source.availability: completed UTC source hour plus fixed 180 seconds
source.known_official_source_limitation: Xatu canonical_beacon_block_deposit public files are documented only through 2025-05-14; a positive pre-2024 result requires a separate full-period deposit-contract source before complete official evaluation

economic_screen.primary_event: net locked ETH in the prior-only rolling 720-hour lower or upper decile
economic_screen.control_event: control amount in its own prior-only rolling 720-hour upper decile
economic_screen.entry: first observable ETHUSDT one-minute open after source availability plus fixed 500ms order latency
economic_screen.long_geometry: completed event-hour low structural invalidation and prior-only 24-hour high objective
economic_screen.short_geometry: completed event-hour high structural invalidation and prior-only 24-hour low objective
economic_screen.gap_stop: observed one-minute open when beyond structural stop
economic_screen.stage_boundary: mark and stop new entries; never strategy-close; unresolved labels excluded from model fit
economic_screen.model: eight fixed-seed event-bootstrap HGBT regressors of direct 24bp account action value; score equals mean minus 0.5 standard deviation

requirements: net-staking ML policy ends above 10000 USDT in development and confirmation
net-staking exact positive-winner deletion and full rerouting ends above 10000 USDT in both forward stages
net-staking policy exceeds deposit-only and principal-release controls in both stages
no forced liquidation or prohibited elapsed-time exit

prohibitions: no change to source definitions or signed net-flow construction after market outcomes
no threshold, rolling-window, quantile, delay, action-geometry, cost, risk or leverage rescue
no 2024-2026 opening without a pass and a separately frozen full-period deposit source
